name: eczid-mcp-trust
description: See what the MCP servers configured in a workspace expose: which servers are declared, how they launch, which environment key names look credential-shaped, and whether any ECZ-ID public proof reference exists. Inspection only: OBSERVED, never ENFORCED. Free.
